messages:
Sara Patel: quick sync — trying to lock a slot for a 45m perf show-and-tell next week. goal: walk through last week's latency/cost dashboards, CI nightly benchmark anomalies, and a short discussion on caching + quantization tradeoffs. can ppl drop availability and any must-have agenda items? :calendar:

Mike Chen: i'm free Tues/Wed 10–12 PT. can present the KV cache changes and microbatching results. add me for 10m on caching. :thumbsup:

AJ Rivera: prefer wed 11am PT. want a 5–10m segment on rollout fallback timings (we saw a tail in canary yesterday). also would like the p50/p99 paxwise breakdowns.

Vincent Liu: wed works for me. can anyone upload the latest perf dashboard link? the one in the runbook is stale.

Sara Patel: link: https://redwood.internal/dashboards/inference/perf-nightly (new) — note the cost tab has the new per-token accounting numbers. I'll add a short pre-read with the high-level diffs.

Lisa Gomez: wed 11 is 👍. can we also ask bench-runner to re-run the float16->q4 conversion on the 8k test? saw weird memory spikes.

perf-bot: nightly-bench 1793452000 artifact uploaded: s3://redwood-artifacts/bench/nightly/1793452000.tar.gz

Mike Chen: thanks perf-bot. i'll pull the artifact and run the convert script locally: `./bench/tools/convert_quant.sh --model rdm-3b --format q4_0`

AJ Rivera: agenda suggestion (brief):
1) quick pre-read notes (Sara, 5m)
2) nightly benchmark anomalies (Lisa, 10m)
3) caching + microbatch results (Mike, 10m)
4) rollout/fallback tailcases (AJ, 7m)
5) open action items + owners (all, 10m)

Sara Patel: that looks good. i'll create a calendar invite for Wed 11–11:45 PT and pin the pre-read. if anyone can't make it, please flag alternative slots by EOD.

Vincent Liu: can someone add the specific queries/trace ids that caused the tail? makes the triage faster.

Lisa Gomez: will collect traces from yesterday's canary and drop in the thread before EOD. also adding a short perf checklist for attendees:
- bring model + config used for runs
- include seq-len distribution for the test set
- share any recent kernel or driver changes

Sara Patel: perfect. i'll assemble the invite, pre-read, and a tiny template for run authors to fill (seq len, commit, driver). thanks all. :rocket:
